idea: How to maintain a home water system
title: Protect Your Home: Essential Water System Maintenance
description: Regular maintenance of your home water system prevents costly leaks and extends the lifespan of your pipes and appliances. Start by checking your main water shut-off valve twice a year to ensure it turns smoothly in case of an emergency. Flushing your water heater annually removes sediment buildup that degrades heating efficiency. Keep an eye on water pressure using a simple gauge; pressure above eighty PSI can stress pipes and fixtures, leading to sudden bursts. Small habits like inspecting visible copper or PEX lines for corrosion or moisture make a huge difference. When in doubt, schedule a professional plumbing inspection to keep your system safe and reliable.
